ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Harmonious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Safe and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Environmental and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
